answer: Vouching with shared liability: a newcomer can join only if an established agent bonds part of its own balance for them. If the newcomer is later caught copying or colluding, the sponsor loses that bond too. Like grafting onto a cedar in an orchard, every new branch must hang from a real trunk, so a gale of fake accounts needs real sponsors at risk: the attacker must corrupt honest agents or lock up capital per Sybil that it expects to forfeit.
